title: Limit Max Photos per Album | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Limit Max Photos per Album Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000056879 Overview Creating photo albums is a highly beneficial feature for members in certain industries, such as real estate, design and more. With the Limit Max Photos per Album add-on, reward the higher-tier members by allowing them to publish more photos per album than the lower-tier members. How To Get This Add-On Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club Purchase Individually: Limit Max Photos Per Album Add-On Enable the Add-On 1. Go to Finance >> Membership Plans 2. Click Edit for the level the admin wishes to modify the limit to. 3. Click on the Post Publishing tab. 4. The admin can limit the number of images that the member can upload per photo album: For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
